aviation_incidents.headline: 俄羅斯Su-30加里寧格勒訓練中墜毀 機組員彈射獲救
aviation_incidents.summary: 俄羅斯國防部表示，一架Su-30於2026年10月21日在加里寧格勒地區執行預定訓練飛行時墜毀；機組員彈射後由地面搜救隊尋獲，飛行員生命無虞。另有媒體引述未具名消息人士稱，機型為Su-30SM且兩名飛行員受傷，相關說法尚未獲官方確認。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Russian Su-30 Crashes During Training in Kaliningrad, Crew Ejects and Is Recovered
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Russia’s Defense Ministry said a Su-30 crashed during a scheduled training flight in the Kaliningrad region on October 21, 2026. The crew ejected and was found by a ground search-and-rescue team; the ministry said the pilots’ lives were not in danger. Media reports citing unnamed sources identified the aircraft as a Su-30SM and said both pilots were injured, claims not confirmed by the ministry.

sources.name: AeroTime — Russian Su-30 fighter crashes in Kaliningrad, pilots eject

aviation_incidents.headline: 美國航空波音787在O’Hare緊急降落 報導稱一人住院
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國航空一架波音787-8在O’Hare（ORD）緊急降落，並在跑道上停下。機師降落前警告可能有煞車問題；報導稱一人住院，現有資訊未確認煞車問題是否為事故原因。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: American Airlines Boeing 787 Makes Emergency Landing at O’Hare; One Reported Hospitalized
aviation_incidents.summary_en: An American Airlines Boeing 787-8 made an emergency landing at O’Hare (ORD) and came to a stop on the runway. The pilots had warned of a possible brake problem before landing; a report said one person was hospitalized. The available information does not confirm whether a brake issue caused the event.

sources.name: Simple Flying — American Airlines Boeing 787’s Brakes Drag In O’Hare Emerge…

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航A330-300 B-18306傳退租 Flightradar24列出桃園晚間離場紀錄
taiwan_aviation.summary: 消息指華航A330-300 B-18306已退租，但華航尚未正式確認退租或後續移交安排。Flightradar24列出該機執行CI77於2026年10月21日臺北時間22時19分自桃園離場，未顯示目的地，紀錄也未確認航班完成或退租交付。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines A330-300 B-18306 Reportedly Returned Off Lease; Tracker Lists Evening Taoyuan Departure
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Information indicates that China Airlines A330-300 B-18306 has been returned off lease, but the airline has not formally confirmed the return or handover arrangements. Flightradar24 lists flight CI77 departing Taoyuan at 10:19 p.m. Taipei time on October 21, 2026. No destination is shown, and the record does not confirm the flight’s completion or a lease-return handover.

sources.name: Flightradar24 — B-18306 aircraft identity and departure listing (not confirmation of lease return)

taiwan_aviation.headline: 民航局宣布明日國內線全數取消 國際航班仍可能調整
taiwan_aviation.summary: 民航局表示，依業者最新資訊，明日國內線全數取消，國際航班也可能因颱風持續調整，提醒旅客出發前向航空公司確認。民航局統計，截至今日18時，國內線取消126架次、國際線取消40架次，主要涉及往返沖繩航班。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan CAA Says All Domestic Flights Will Be Canceled Tomorrow; International Schedules May Change
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration said all domestic flights are scheduled to be canceled tomorrow, while international schedules may continue to change because of the typhoon. It urged passengers to check with their airline before departure. As of 18:00 today, 126 domestic and 40 international flights had been canceled, with the international cancellations mainly involving Okinawa services.

sources.name: CAA Taiwan — 颱風逼近，國內線明日全數取消，民航局提醒留意航班異動

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航前四川航空A350 B-18923投入載客服務 首航桃園飛成田
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航第三架由四川航空轉入的A350-900、註冊編號B-18923，於10月22日執行CI104桃園飛往東京成田，開始華航載客營運。華航目前仍以2026年底前接收首批兩架787為目標，尚未公布更精確交付日期。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines’ Ex-Sichuan A350 B-18923 Enters Passenger Service With Taoyuan–Narita First Flight
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines’ third Airbus A350-900 transferred from Sichuan Airlines, registration B-18923, entered passenger service on October 22 with CI104 from Taoyuan to Tokyo Narita. The airline still targets delivery of its first two Boeing 787s by the end of 2026 and has not announced a more precise date.

sources.name: Taiwan News — China Airlines 787-9 delivery update

international_aviation.headline: Aeromexico預告將公布新增墨西哥城直飛航班的美國城市
international_aviation.summary: Aeromexico預告將公布哪些美國城市新增直飛墨西哥城的航班，相關航點尚未揭曉。資訊稱公布時間最快可能在下週，但日期未確定；這是航點公布預告，並非航班已開始營運。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aeromexico Plans to Reveal US Cities for New Nonstop Flights to Mexico City
international_aviation.summary_en: Aeromexico is expected to announce which US cities will receive new nonstop flights to Mexico City, but the cities have not been identified. The announcement could come as soon as next week, though the timing is uncertain. The information concerns a forthcoming route announcement, not flights already in operation.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Aeromexico Set To Reveal Which US Cities Are Getting New No…

international_aviation.headline: 加拿大航空休閒品牌737 MAX 8將增設座椅螢幕、可後躺座椅及免費Wi-Fi
international_aviation.summary: 加拿大航空休閒品牌的波音737 MAX 8將配備座椅背螢幕、可後躺座椅及免費Wi-Fi。相關機隊調整也將更新後的737 MAX飛機納入Air Canada Rouge。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Canada Leisure Brand’s 737 MAX 8s to Get Seatback Screens, Reclining Seats and Free Wi-Fi
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Canada’s leisure airline will add seatback screens, reclining seats and free Wi-Fi to its Boeing 737 MAX 8s. The fleet reshuffle also brings updated 737 MAX aircraft into Air Canada Rouge.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Air Canada's Leisure Airline Is Getting Seatback Screens, R…

international_aviation.headline: 日本航空取消未來數日在九座機場的航班
international_aviation.summary: 日本航空已取消未來數日在九座機場的航班。現有資訊未列出受影響的機場、航班班次或確切日期；報導將航班調整置於颱風Champi威脅亞洲樞紐的背景下。
international_aviation.headline_en: Japan Airlines Cancels Flights at Nine Airports in Coming Days
international_aviation.summary_en: Japan Airlines has canceled flights at nine airports over the coming days. The available information does not identify the airports, flight numbers or specific dates; the cancellations are described amid Typhoon Champi’s threat to Asian hubs.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Typhoon Champi Threatens Asian Hubs With Flight Cuts: Milit…

international_aviation.headline: 勞斯萊斯擴大CorporateCare Enhanced保障 維持每小時費率
international_aviation.summary: 勞斯萊斯將為企業飛機引擎維護計畫CorporateCare Enhanced增加輕微異物損傷、零件退運等保障，並表示不提高每小時費率。重大異物損傷仍不在保障範圍，符合資格的Pearl引擎客戶另可獲壽命限制零件保障。
international_aviation.headline_en: Rolls-Royce Expands CorporateCare Enhanced Coverage Without Raising Hourly Rate
international_aviation.summary_en: Rolls-Royce will add coverage for minor foreign-object damage, parts return shipping and other costs to its CorporateCare Enhanced business-jet engine maintenance program without increasing its hourly rate. Major foreign-object damage remains excluded. Eligible Pearl engine customers will also receive coverage for life-limited parts when they reach their prescribed limits.

sources.name: AeroTime — Rolls-Royce expands CorporateCare to reduce aircraft owners…

international_aviation.headline: Civil Air Patrol訂購21架塞斯納飛機 支援搜救、救災與青年計畫
international_aviation.summary: Civil Air Patrol向Textron Aviation訂購21架新製塞斯納活塞飛機，用於搜救、災害應變、訓練及青年計畫，預計2027年完成交付。訂單包括Skyhawk 172、Skylane 182、Turbo Skylane T182T及Turbo Stationair HD 206。
international_aviation.headline_en: Civil Air Patrol Orders 21 Cessna Aircraft for Search, Disaster Response and Youth Programs
international_aviation.summary_en: Civil Air Patrol ordered 21 new Cessna piston aircraft from Textron Aviation for search and rescue, disaster response, training and youth programs. Deliveries are expected to be completed in 2027. The order includes Skyhawk 172s, Skylane 182s, Turbo Skylane T182Ts and a Turbo Stationair HD 206.

sources.name: AeroTime — Civil Air Patrol orders 21 Cessna aircraft for search and r…

international_aviation.headline: BETA Technologies獲FAA市場調查特別適航證 10月20日完成首趟授權飛行
international_aviation.summary: FAA授予BETA Technologies市場調查用途特別適航證，允許其以ALIA VTOL A250搭載客戶與合作夥伴飛行。公司於2026年10月20日宣布獲證，並於當天完成首趟相關飛行：由紐約州普拉茨堡飛往佛蒙特州伯靈頓，航程34海里、歷時20分鐘。
international_aviation.headline_en: BETA Technologies Gets FAA Market-Survey Certificate and Completes First Authorized Flight on October 20
international_aviation.summary_en: The FAA granted BETA Technologies a Special Airworthiness Certificate for market surveys, allowing it to fly customers and partners on its ALIA VTOL A250. The company announced the authorization on October 20, 2026, and completed its first flight under the status that day. The 20-minute flight covered 34 nautical miles from Plattsburgh, New York, to Burlington, Vermont.

sources.name: AeroTime — FAA allows BETA Technologies to fly customers on ALIA eVTOL
